## Publication gate

- Owner approval date:

## Post-merge closeout

- [ ] Remote `main` verified at the expected commit.
- [ ] Canonical local checkout synchronized.
- [ ] Merged task branch confirmed to contain no unique work.
- [ ] Task branch removed or its retention explained.
- [ ] Remaining dirty, ignored, or unresolved state reported.
